name: multitenant-mfe-poc
description: Micro-frontend multitenant POC: Vite + Module Federation, React, per-tenant feature flags via local JSON config.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=dashboard && npm run build --workspace=analytics && npm run build --workspace=settings && npm run build --workspace=shell
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n dashboard,analytics,settings,shell -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run preview --workspace=dashboard" "npm run preview --workspace=analytics" "npm run preview --workspace=settings" "npm run preview --workspace=shell"
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=dashboard && npm run build --workspace=analytics && npm run build --workspace=settings && concurrently -n dashboard,analytics,settings,shell -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run preview --workspace=dashboard" "npm run preview --workspace=analytics" "npm run preview --workspace=settings" "npm run dev --workspace=shell"
